clue.text: Disconsolate at cutting supplies of electricity

indicators.note: the words for being down and 'at' cut into the word for supplies, sitting between its letters

parts.note: a kit is a set of equipment or supplies
disconsolate means low in spirits

explanation.surface: A downcast person is responsible for interrupting the power supply.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Supplies of electricity' reads as one phrase, but 'supplies' is wordplay. The definition is loose: a kilowatt is a unit of electricity, with 'of' as a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A kilowatt is a unit of electrical power, a thousand watts.

clue.text: Efface some rude lewd graffiti

indicators.note: some of the letters of the phrase rude lewd are taken, a run inside them

explanation.surface: Someone wants to erase a bit of obscene wall-scrawl.
explanation.definitionFit: Dele is the proofreader's instruction to delete or strike out text.

clue.text: Used foil within limits

explanation.surface: A fencer used a foil while staying inside the piste.
explanation.definitionFit: One who used a foil was fencing (sword sport); land fenced is enclosed, kept inside boundaries.

clue.text: Defence body taking time to give guidance to musicians

parts.note: the MoD is Britain's Ministry of Defence
an era is a period of time
taken as written

explanation.surface: A military ministry takes its time before issuing instructions to a band.
explanation.walkthrough: MOD is the UK Ministry of Defence; 'taking' just strings the pieces together.
explanation.definitionFit: Moderato is a tempo marking telling players to perform at a moderate pace.

clue.text: Practical when dealing with a certain issue — clever, too

parts.note: a reason is the matter or cause in question
able means clever or capable

explanation.surface: Someone praised as sensible about a particular matter, and bright as well.
explanation.definitionFit: Reasonable here means sensible and realistic, the sense of a workable proposal.

clue.text: A qualified person blessing an animal

parts.note: a BA is a Bachelor of Arts, a graduate
a boon is a blessing or benefit

explanation.surface: A graduate gives a benediction to a creature.
explanation.definitionFit: A baboon is a large monkey, so an example of an animal.

clue.text: Without ups and downs in the main

definitions.text: Without ups and downs in the main

parts.words: Without ups and downs in the main
parts.note: reads as 'mostly steady', but the main is the sea, and its ups and downs are the rise and fall of the water

explanation.definitionFit: Tideless describes a sea, like the Mediterranean, whose level barely rises or falls.

clue.text: Char about fifty and unmarried

indicators.note: the word for char goes around the numeral, enclosing it

parts.note: to char is to singe or scorch
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A cleaning lady of around fifty who has never wed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Char' suggests a British charwoman (cleaner), but it is the verb meaning to scorch.
explanation.definitionFit: Single is the standard word for someone who is not married.

clue.text: Done by a single individual giving no name

indicators.note: giving in the sense of yielding or bending, so the letters of no name are rearranged

explanation.surface: A one-person job, with the doer remaining anonymous.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-man show or band is performed by just a lone person.

clue.text: A fellow at bay?

explanation.surface: A man standing at the edge of the shore.
explanation.definitionFit: Cove is old British slang for a chap; a cove is also a small sheltered inlet of the sea.

clue.text: Study a form of switch

parts.note: to con is to study or learn carefully
a version is a particular form of something

explanation.surface: An instruction to examine one variety of electrical switch.
explanation.definitionFit: A conversion is a change from one thing to another, as in switching currencies or faiths.

clue.text: Georgia made haste and appeared out of breath

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia
sped means hurried

explanation.surface: Someone from Georgia hurried and was left panting.
explanation.definitionFit: To have gasped is to have drawn breath sharply, the sign of being winded.

clue.text: Train for the parade

explanation.surface: Rehearsing for a march.
explanation.definitionFit: A train can be a line of followers or attendants; a parade is a ceremonial line moving along.

clue.text: Pupil winning scholarship

parts.note: L stands for learner, as on British learner-driver plates
earning means gaining or winning

explanation.surface: A student gains an award to fund their studies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scholarship' suggests a grant, but here it means knowledge acquired by study.
explanation.definitionFit: Scholarship as erudition: knowledge gained through study.

clue.text: Girl with a number on chest

parts.note: Thora is a girl's name
X is the Roman numeral ten

explanation.surface: A girl with a numeral printed on her shirt front.
explanation.definitionFit: The thorax is the part of the body between neck and abdomen, the chest.

clue.text: One can't split a drink in Spain

indicators.note: the words one and can't split the word for a drink, going between its letters

parts.note: ale is a drink, beer
I is the Roman numeral one
taken as written, without its apostrophe

explanation.surface: Someone unable to share a drink while on holiday in Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the place indicated by 'in Spain'.
explanation.definitionFit: Alicante is a port city on Spain's Costa Blanca.

clue.text: The company medico at a fight

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, stands for a doctor

explanation.surface: A firm's doctor gets into a scrap.
explanation.definitionFit: Combat is armed fighting or a struggle.

clue.text: A sad sign offering rent reduction

parts.note: a rent is a tear or rip
a drop is a fall or reduction

explanation.surface: A gloomy notice announcing that rents will fall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rent' reads as money paid for housing; it is a rip.
explanation.definitionFit: A teardrop is a visible token of sorrow on the cheek.

clue.text: Orders new stance to be adopted

indicators.note: a new version of the word stance, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Instructions for a fresh position to be taken.
explanation.definitionFit: Enacts means decrees or ordains, as a legislature does a law.

clue.text: Unconventional note struck in a home

parts.note: B is a note of the musical scale

indicators.note: struck as in knocked about, so the letters of in a home are rearranged

explanation.surface: A musical note sounds out oddly in a house.
explanation.definitionFit: Bohemian describes an artistic, free-spirited lifestyle outside social norms.

clue.text: Plainly just accepting work-out

indicators.note: the word for just takes the exercise abbreviation inside it

parts.note: only means just or merely
PE is physical education, exercise

explanation.surface: Simply agreeing to an exercise session.
explanation.definitionFit: Openly means frankly, without concealment.

clue.text: Extremely basic cover

parts.note: reads as 'very minimal protection', but means a covering for an extremity at the base of the body, the foot's tip

explanation.definitionFit: A toecap is a reinforced covering over the front of a shoe or boot.

clue.text: "Nae man can - - time or tide." burns' "tam o'Shanter"

definitions.text: "Nae man can - - time or tide." burns' "tam o'Shanter"

parts.words: "Nae man can - - time or tide." burns' "tam o'Shanter"
parts.note: a fill-in-the-blank quotation from Robert Burns's poem Tam o' Shanter: no man can bind or tie down time or tide

explanation.definitionFit: The missing verb means to tie or restrain, completing Burns's line about time and tide waiting for no one.

clue.text: A rip can set out to be quite a pet!

indicators.note: out as in disordered, so the letters of a rip can set are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tear in a tin is set to be a real darling.
explanation.definitionFit: A Persian cat is a long-haired breed kept as a pampered pet.

clue.text: Pygmalion's sister got nothing done

parts.note: did means done, performed
O is the zero, nothing

explanation.surface: The sister of a legendary sculptor accomplished zero.
explanation.walkthrough: Pygmalion suggests the sculptor, but here it is the king of Tyre, brother of the queen of Carthage in Virgil's Aeneid.
explanation.definitionFit: Dido, legendary founder and queen of Carthage, was the sibling of King Pygmalion of Tyre.

clue.text: What's fair about quiet cheat

indicators.note: the word for what is fair goes around the musical abbreviation

parts.note: what is due is what is owed or fair
p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: A fair amount said softly about a swindle.
explanation.definitionFit: To dupe is to deceive or trick someone.

clue.text: Innings finished with maximum effort

explanation.surface: A cricket team's batting is over after a full-strength attempt.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a side is all out when ten of its batters are dismissed, ending its innings.
explanation.definitionFit: A team dismissed ends its innings; going flat out means giving total effort.

clue.text: A driver always listening for the whistle

definitions.text: A driver always listening for the whistle

parts.words: A driver always listening for the whistle
parts.note: suggests a motorist or engine driver awaiting a signal, but the driver herds livestock and obeys a shepherd's whistled commands

explanation.definitionFit: A sheepdog is a working dog that drives flocks on its handler's whistled signals.
